design: Standard indirect-object completion, two narrative surfaces, sixteen name pairs, both initial name orders and both giver choices. Correct recipient is other name. Complete four-cell item gate. Source values are initial two names; later giver mention is permitted.
gate_scope: Each task/format independently; require candidate>=.75 separately for query to first and second displayed fact. No correctness-based item removal.
future_contrast: Giver-to-first versus giver-to-second; same preceding prefix, fixed first-name logprob and first-vs-second margin readout; candidate and full-vocabulary competence. No mechanism re-selection.
limitation: Distinct from repeated identical-value copying, but still short two-fact retrieval; no general manifold inference.
